ops.oldText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and is related, directly or indirectly, to the Services; or
ops.newText: 3. that is brought by a Services Recipient and arises out of the Content, the Customer Components or Customer's breach of applicable law; or

input.comment: [Playbook] We narrowed our indemnity so it covers claims arising from our own Content, Customer Components and legal compliance rather than any Services Recipient claim "related, directly or indirectly, to the Services" — as drafted we would be underwriting IBM's own service delivery. Our playbook keeps the customer indemnity limited to customer-provided content and customer breach of law.
input.summary: Narrow Customer's indemnity in Section 8.2(a)(3) to Customer Content/Components and Customer's breach of law.
